scope_limits: Direction-only conditioning experiment; physical operator, Armijo trials, final installer and original Newton certificate logic are unchanged.
Block S is built fresh from the current candidate, accepted history, scheduler, and existing production tangent builder. Invalid/free-mass/block/mask inputs fail closed.
Strict selected CGLS FEM scope and E<=2,N<=4096,T<=32768 remain inherited. Human, contact, multiphysics, and unsupported constraints are not added.

Root-reported native457 evidence was mixed: block right scaling improved the linear residual, but alpha=1 nonlinear residual was worse than unscaled (5.88705e-5 vs 4.83878e-5); no performance or convergence benefit is claimed.
CPU tests cover recurrence/layout/failure behavior only; production Metal parity and full-coupon outcomes remain unqualified.
